add_definitions(
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__ROS_LONG64__)

spec2def(msdmo.dll msdmo.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# msdmo.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/msdmo-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(msdmo_shims OBJECT dmoreg.c dmort.c)
target_link_libraries(msdmo_shims PRIVATE wine dmoguids strmiids uuid libuser32 libadvapi32 libole32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU")
    target_compile_options(msdmo_shims PRIVATE -Wno-array-parameter)
endif()
set_wine_module(msdmo_shims)
add_dependencies(msdmo_shims wineheaders)
add_cargo_module(msdmo msdmo-cargo msdmo.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS msdmo_shims psdk uuid_sources)
